rv.q: Impish and brimming with originality, this is fringe theatre at its most scintillating and inventive.

Pick the premise apart if you want to: there is, for instance, the overarching belief in a utopian afterlife (aka Heaven) in any event. But again, this is somewhat besides the point. While most of the congregation get up and leave, a relatively small number remain, hanging on the pastor’s every word.
Leonhard-Hooper and Brasch are, of course, fantastically talented as both writers and performers.
This is a show unlike anything I have ever seen before, and I found myself as enraptured as any show I have ever seen about the rapture.
